subcategory: Blue Flag Certified Tropical White Sand Shoreline
description: Voted the Best Beach in Asia by Time Magazine, a pristine two-kilometer curve of powder-white coral sand flanked by lush tropical mahua rainforests and crystalline turquoise waters on Swaraj Dweep.
why_visit: Walk barefoot on sugar-soft sand, swim in calm turquoise waters, watch glorious fiery sunsets over the Andaman Sea, and enjoy international-standard eco-certified facilities.
best_time_to_visit: October to May (Best sunset 4:45 PM - 5:30 PM)
activities: Swimming; Sunset Photography; Beach Combing; Tropical Forest Walking
distance_from_nearest_famous_place: 11 km from Havelock Jetty / 55 km catamaran ride from Port Blair
notes: Awarded prestigious Blue Flag certification; swimming permitted only until sunset.

place_name: Cellular Jail National Memorial Port Blair
subcategory: Colonial Panopticon Prison (Kala Pani) & National Freedom Memorial
description: Constructed by the British between 1896 and 1906, a formidable seven-winged panopticon prison known as 'Kala Pani', where prominent Indian freedom fighters like Veer Savarkar and Batukeshwar Dutt were exiled and subjected to solitary confinement.
why_visit: Walk through solitary confinement cells, visit Veer Savarkar's preserved cell, attend the poignant evening Sound and Light Show narrated in the voice of Om Puri, and pay solemn homage at the eternal freedom flame.
best_time_to_visit: October to April (9:00 AM - 5:00 PM, Closed Mondays; Sound & Light show 6:00 PM)
activities: Historic Prison Tour; Veer Savarkar Cell Homage; Sound and Light Show Attendance; Museum Gallery Inspection
notes: Originally had seven wings radiating like bicycle spokes from a central watchtower; three wings survive today.

subcategory: Pristine Coral Reef Beach & Glass-Bottom Boat Rides
description: Located adjacent to Neil Island Jetty on Shaheed Dweep, celebrated for expansive shallow white sands, calm turquoise waters, and vibrant live coral reefs teeming with colorful tropical clownfish, sea anemones, and giant clams.
why_visit: Ride glass-bottom boats directly over living coral gardens, snorkel with vibrant marine life, swim safely in gentle crystal-clear waters, and enjoy a relaxed, slow-paced island atmosphere.
best_time_to_visit: October to May (Morning hours offer best water clarity for coral viewing)
activities: Glass-Bottom Boat Coral Viewing; Snorkeling; Scuba Diving; Jet Skiing; White Sand Beach Combing
distance_from_nearest_famous_place: 500 m from Neil Island Jetty / 40 km catamaran ride from Port Blair
notes: Best beach in Neil Island for water sports; combines well with the Natural Bridge on the island.
